summary: Fix addresses the reported symptom (options not cleared) but does so by deleting every key of self.options absent from operation.options, whereas AlterModelOptions only manages ALTER_OPTION_KEYS. It will wrongly drop CreateModel options that AlterModelOptions never controls (e.g. unique_together, index_together, constraints, order_with_respect_to).

issues.description: Deletion is unbounded: loop removes ALL self.options keys not in operation.options. AlterModelOptions.state_forwards only removes keys in AlterModelOptions.ALTER_OPTION_KEYS. Correct fix must restrict deletion to operation.ALTER_OPTION_KEYS so non-managed options set on CreateModel are preserved.

Regression: squashing AlterModelOptions(options={}) into a CreateModel that carries options outside ALTER_OPTION_KEYS (unique_together, index_together, constraints, verbose_name coexisting) will strip those non-managed options, diverging from unsquashed state_forwards semantics and altering resulting model state.
Because behavior is not aligned with AlterModelOptions semantics, the fix only resolves the empty/full-clear case shown in the report and mishandles partial-option scenarios.
